records.title: Alert on the Report of Substandard and Falsified BETACLOX Found in Nigeria
records.alert_scope: Nigeria
records.curation_note: The alert reports that the registration number displayed on the suspected BETACLOX product belongs to a different product. Preserve the alert's wording and scope; do not generalize this finding to every package bearing the BETACLOX name.

records.title: Alert on the Sale of Unregistered ZACEF-TZ Injection in Circulation in Nigeria
records.alert_scope: Nigeria; product discovered in FCT, Abuja
records.curation_note: NAFDAC reports that the stated registration number A-46344 does not exist in its database. The alert also reports missing manufacturer details and patient information leaflet. Do not infer that other products with similar names or ingredients are affected. The alert concerns a specific reported product and batch.

records.title: Alert on the Sale of Counterfeit Cialis Tablet 20mg in Nigeria
records.alert_scope: Nigeria; counterfeit product reported during market surveillance in Abuja
records.curation_note: NAFDAC distinguishes the counterfeit product label, stated NRN 4464 and lot E3242401 from the genuine reference product, Cialis 20mg film-coated tablets, NRN 04-5196. Do not infer that all Cialis products or batches are affected.

records.title: Recall of Amoxivue (Amoxicillin) 500mg Capsules due to significantly low Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient content
records.alert_scope: Nigeria; samples reported from Sokoto and Plateau State
records.curation_note: NAFDAC reports a significantly low API content of 26.3% and other laboratory specification failures for the recalled batch. Do not generalize the batch-specific finding to every amoxicillin product.

records.title: Alert on the Voluntary Recall of Sporidex Suspension 125 mg/5 mL, Batch No. DFG4606A
records.alert_scope: Nigeria; voluntary recall notice
records.curation_note: Batch-specific voluntary recall reported in the linked NAFDAC notice. Additional package and manufacturing fields remain null until transcribed from the notice. Do not infer that all Sporidex batches are affected.

records.title: Seizure of suspected substandard and falsified BPPL Artemether/Lumefantrine 80mg/480mg
records.alert_scope: Suspected substandard and falsified product reported in Kano; the notice identifies the stated registration number as fake.
records.curation_note: Transcribed from the official NAFDAC notice. Preserve the batch-specific scope.

records.title: Suspected counterfeit Pulmicort (Budesonide) inhalation suspension
records.product_ingredients: Budesonide (claimed by resemblance to Pulmicort; composition not independently confirmed)
records.alert_scope: NAFDAC reported suspected counterfeit Ulmicort marketed to resemble Pulmicort; reported in Eastern Nigeria.
records.curation_note: The notice describes a suspected counterfeit product. Do not treat the claimed composition as laboratory-confirmed.

records.title: Suspected counterfeit products mimicking Forxiga (Dapagliflozin)
records.product_ingredients: Dapagliflozin (products mimic the Forxiga brand; composition not independently confirmed)
records.alert_scope: NAFDAC reported suspected counterfeit products named Forzigar and Foziga in Eastern Nigeria. The notice lists two distinct batches.
records.curation_note: Two products and batches are listed in one official notice. Do not infer that every dapagliflozin product is affected.

records.title: Marketing and sale of unregistered Menofix composition
records.alert_scope: Official NAFDAC notice concerning the marketing and sale of an unregistered Menofix composition. No batch is asserted here.
records.curation_note: Only the product and unregistered status are recorded here; ingredient and batch details are left unspecified.

records.title: WHO alert on substandard ACCUPAQUE, OMNIPAQUE and VISIPAQUE
records.product_name: ACCUPAQUE, OMNIPAQUE and VISIPAQUE injection solutions
records.alert_scope: The notice concerns specified batches supplied in 100 ml polypropylene containers. It does not state that all batches or glass-container presentations are affected. Consult the source for the full batch list.
records.curation_note: Multi-product, batch-scoped quality alert. The full affected batch list remains in the official source.

records.title: Counterfeit Augmentin 625mg tablets, batch AC3N
records.alert_scope: NAFDAC reports counterfeit/falsified Augmentin tablets bearing batch AC3N. The displayed dates were inconsistent with the genuine manufacturer's records.
records.curation_note: Manufacturing and expiry dates recorded here are those displayed on the suspect sample, not verified production dates.

records.title: Counterfeit Proguanil brands with fake NAFDAC registration number 04-6433
records.alert_scope: NAFDAC states that registration number 04-6433 belongs to a different registered product. Consult the notice for the complete product details.
records.curation_note: The stated registration number is reported as belonging to a different product. No batch is inferred. Reference product details omitted pending direct confirmation from the official notice.

records.title: Mop-up of counterfeit and unregistered Otrivin nasal drops
records.product_name: Otrivin Nasal Drops for children and adults
records.alert_scope: The notice lists counterfeit children's and adult nasal-drop products under two batches. Both batches are within the notice scope; neither is a blanket alert for all nasal drops.
records.curation_note: The source gives the same displayed manufacturing and expiry dates for the two counterfeit rows. No registration number is assigned to the counterfeit rows.

records.title: Confirmed counterfeit Herceptin 600mg
records.alert_scope: NAFDAC reports a confirmed counterfeit batch A8519B34 in Lagos. Chemical analysis was not possible because a physical sample was unavailable.
records.curation_note: Batch and dates are transcribed from the suspect product details in the notice.
